title: Megan Thee Stallion Serves ‘Body’ During ‘Dream Come True’ 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show Performance
summary: Tate McRae, KATSEYE and Megan Moroney also hit the runway.
contentText:
Megan Thee Stallion turned her dreams into reality on Sunday (Oct. 18), making her debut at the 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.

Related

Watch KATSEYE Put the Pink in ‘Pinky Up’ & Strut the Runway at 2026 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show

Megan Moroney Reveals What She Listens to Before Performing At the Victoria Secret Fashion Show 2026

The Houston Hottie earned her glittery wings as she strutted down the VSFS runway while performing her empowering “Body” anthem, which reached No. 12 on the Billboard Hot 100 in December 2020.

Megan closed out the show, serving body with a breathtaking lingerie look as she leaned into her Tina Snow persona with blonde hair, shiny platinum wings, a lace bra, black thong and silvery tights. “Are there any Hotties in here tonight?” she asked the crowd, which drew a loud response.

The models received a jolt from the energy in the room with Megan at the helm, as she slayed the stage in her VSFS debut, even without her signature twerking on the runway during the performance.

In a pink carpet interview before the show, Megan Thee Stallion recalled her mom having Victoria’s Secret packages at the door regularly, and young Meg would get inspired reading the catalogs they’d come with featuring all of the Angels.

“She had the packages at the door every week and I would look in the magazines and look like, ‘These ladies are so beautiful. I want to be that when I grow up.’ Dreams do come true,” Megan told VS before breaking out into singing Hilary Duff’s “What Dreams Are Made of.”

Megan wasn’t the only superstar to hit the stage, as Tate McRae delivered the live debut of her “Housewife” single, and KATSEYE and Megan Moroney also hit the stage for their first Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show performances.

The Houston Hottie has been heating up while the fans await her next era, which will be Act III. She’s released a pair of “Tina Tuesday Freestyles,” and she’s promising another installment in the series on Oct. 20.
